fact: On 14 October 2026 Prime Minister Amadou Oury Bah said the government has required the public-procurement price lists of the statistics institute (INSE) and the procurement regulator (ACGP) to integrate artificial intelligence, to be tested by the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Budget.
title: Forum international des SGG à Conakry : Bah Oury mise sur l'IA pour moderniser l'action gouvernementale
